name: prompt-coach
description: Rates your draft while it sits in the prompt box, says what is missing when it is weak, and offers to improve it with a question or two. Never holds a prompt back in the terminal or desktop app; in a cloud session it asks in a card as you send. Long weak drafts get shaped into a brief.

mode.title: When to check
mode.description: before: rate the draft in the prompt box as you type and offer to improve a weak one; after: rate each prompt once it is sent and show the rating above the prompt; off

threshold.title: Offer below
threshold.description: Offer to improve a prompt rated below this score (1 to 5); 3 offers on 1 and 2
